Messages.Author: Cartman
Messages.Body:
Maybe it's a stupid question, but
if vamp A is in combat with vamp B (Blood Brother)
A inflicts more damage than B
C (same circle as B) plays Brother's Blood
Can A play Diasarm on B?

Brother's Blood
Requires a ready Blood Brother of the same circle as one in combat.
[san] This vampire can burn his or her own blood to heal or prevent
destruction from damage taken by a member of this circle in combat.
[SAN] Put this card on this vampire. The vampire with this card can burn his
or her own blood to heal or prevent destruction from damage taken by a
member of this circle in combat. A vampire may have only one Brother`s
Blood.

Disarm
[pot] Only usable at the end of a round of combat in which this vampire
successfully inflicted more damage at close range than the opposing vampire.
Not usable by a vampire being burned or going into torpor. Put this card on
the opposing vampire and send that vampire into torpor. The vampire with
this card has -1 strength. He or she may burn this card by burning 3 blood.
A vampire can have only one Disarm.
[POT] As above, but the vampire with this card has -2 strength.
